court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Appellant(s): Mr. V. Sankar for Mr. R. Kannan
For Respondent(s): Mr. R. Darshan for Mr. N. Manokaran for R 2
judgment_text:
PRAYER To set aside the judgment and decree dated 20.02.2008 passed in A.S. No. 35 of 2007 on the file of the subordinate Court, Pollachi, confirming the judgment and decree dated 26.06.2007 passed in O.S. No. 352 of 2001 on the file of the District Munsif Court, Pollachi.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, J.:— Mr. V. Sankar, learned counsel representing Mr. R. Kannan, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. R. Darshan, learned counsel representing Mr. N. Manokaran, learned counsel for the second respondent submitted that the dispute has been settled before the Mediation Centre attached to this court and that compromise terms have been entered into. A copy of the compromise memo is placed before this court.

2. In the circumstances, the second appeal shall stand disposed of in terms of the terms of compromise. The copy of the compromise memo shall form part of the record. No costs. Consequently, connected applications, if any, shall stand closed.
